profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
As a senior-level software engineer with more than a decade of experience building innovative technical solutions, my role is to develop high-quality software that improves processes, increases efficiencies, and meets organizational objectives.
 
Relying on my strong communication and interpersonal skills, I have a track record of effectively conveying complex technical information to varying proficiencies, mentoring and motivating high-performance teams, and building rapport with key stakeholders. As a detail-oriented, critical thinker, I’m adept at navigating technology challenges and strategically directing multiple complex deliverables in fast-paced, dynamic environments. A life-long learner, I keep current with emerging trends and new technologies through research, professional development courses, and idea-sharing with colleagues.

The Key areas of my expertise include…
 
·     JavaScript Frameworks
·     Serverless Rest API
·     Git, Jenkins, Docker, CI
·     Higher order components (HOC) 
·     Responsive Front End
·     Reusable Components
·     Test-driven Development (TDD)
·     Agile/Scrum Project Management
·     Prototyping
·     IT Strategy & Planning
·     Quality Assurance
·     Process Improvement
·     Research & Analysis
·     Team Building/Development
·     Full Stack Solutions

I always look forward to making new, professional connections on LinkedIn!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II (USCIS-DHS Contractor)
positions.description:
As a senior software engineer, I lead the development team in the creation of high-quality, well-designed front-end solutions imparting user interface (UI), DOM CSS expertise and experience in responsive design. Consistently improving patterns and code quality, I concurrently execute code reviews from other developers. I diligently generate Jira tickets primarily for front-end development tasks to meet sprint deadlines. I collaborate in the coordination, writing, and submission of new stories for future sprint initiatives. As a guide and advisor to junior developers, I assist them with technical problems and safeguarding adherence to standards. I also foster a strong rapport with QA and Product teams to maximize results during ticket creation, development, testing, and delivery.
• Leveraged rich UI knowledge and expertise to create new reusable components to standardize DOM elements resulting more efficient turn-arounds for delivering code in React and Angular.

• Added test coverage unit tests (Karma) to 95% code base code coverage, end-to-end testing with TestCafe framework.

• Achieved quality code of front-end solutions in React, TypeScript, and GraphQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
In this senior-level role, I delivered the highest of quality software development to clients with a focus on ensuring a positive user experience. I inspired transparency by assisting quality assurance (QA) to think through edge cases. I led constructive discussions to enhance UI/API coding standards in all layers of web applications. By refactored restless API endpoints in Node.js, I added theming to all front-end components and templates.
• Increased the efficiency and effectiveness of refactoring and development of API endpoints by leading efforts to implement reusable server-side services.

• Successfully led web application UI development for a corporate client utilizing Angular and TypeScript.

• Collaborated with UX team to enhance the look and feel of front-end pages.
